DUP-001.name: duplicate_active_ingredient
DUP-001.description: Same active ingredient present in two or more distinct prescription items after FDC decomposition. Evidence carries the per-ingredient aggregate daily exposure.

FDC-001.name: prohibited_or_restricted_product
FDC-001.description: Any item whose ingredient set (exact for FDC targets, subset for ingredient targets) carries an in-force PROHIBITED / RESTRICTED / WITHDRAWN regulatory status as of the check date, derived from the event-sourced register.

INT-001.name: severe_interaction_seed
INT-001.description: Any unordered ingredient pair across the whole prescription present in the severe-interaction seed list. Coverage is declared: ingredients absent from the seed list make the check PARTIAL_COVERAGE.

CUM-001.name: cumulative_ingredient_exposure
CUM-001.description: Per-ingredient daily total across all items (units/day x strength). Reported for every shared ingredient; annotated against cited reference ceilings only, never computed for a patient.
